Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
hi !

combat ! opposing vampire has one blood on him. My vamp has 2 blood and
garrote on him.

Can i play lucky blow with the garrote to burn opposing vamp (thus burning
the garrote) ?

Can i play tornsignpost then strike with the garrote to burn opponent ?

Can i play sword of the righteous and strike with the garrote to burn
opponent ?

Is "strike : X damage" and " X damage each strike " different wording for
the same thing ?

reyda
